# Tool Kumar

> Open the biggest JSON out there, at the fastest of speeds. Free, private JSON tools that run in the browser and open JSON files as big as 10 GB. Documents stay on the device and the app works offline after it loads.

## Primary pages

- [JSON viewer and formatter](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/): format, validate, repair, minify, compare and convert JSON.
- [Integrate: View in Tool Kumar](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/integrate): links and buttons that open a JSON document, or two compared, in the viewer. The document travels in the URL fragment (`https://tools.vikasmaur.com/#a=<raw DEFLATE, base64url>&view=tree`). Browsers open links of roughly 1 MB (Firefox) to 2 MB (Chrome, Safari), which holds a few MB of compressed JSON; for bigger JSON, a web app can hand it to a new tab by postMessage instead. The page has copy-paste functions for both (JavaScript and TypeScript) and the logo as SVG, PNG and WebP.
- [Resource library](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/resources): the site's reference pages and guides.
- [JSON syntax reference](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/resources/json-reference): values, objects, arrays, strings, numbers and common invalid forms, with links to RFC 8259 and ECMA-404.
- [JSON examples](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/resources/json-examples): fictional API, configuration and nested-data examples with downloadable files.
- [Blog](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/blogs): guides, research and the history of JSON.
- [JSON formatter privacy study](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/blogs/json-formatter-privacy-study): a dated canary test of twelve online JSON tools, with the [raw capture as JSON](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/research/json-formatter-privacy-study.json).
- [Formatting and validation guide](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/blogs/json-formatting-guide): a practical workflow for finding and fixing syntax errors.
- [Origin of JSON](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/blogs/origin-of-json): the history of the format and its standards.
- [About Tool Kumar](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/about): privacy and processing details.
- [Privacy](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/privacy): what the analytics (Vercel Web Analytics, PostHog) measure, what screen recordings leave out, and how to turn analytics off.

## Dedicated JSON tools

- [All JSON tools](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools): the crawlable index of formatter, validator, conversion and import tools.
- [JSON visualizer](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-visualizer): interactive node-link graph beside the editor, connected object and array cards, branch collapse, search, minimap and local PNG/JPEG/SVG export. Export the whole graph, visible area or selected branch with a theme, white, transparent or custom background and 1×, 2× or 3× resolution. Canvas rendering paints only the visible part for large documents.
- [JSON validator](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-validator): find syntax errors and repair common loose JSON.
- [JSON minifier](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-minifier): remove insignificant whitespace.
- [JSON diff](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-diff): compare two JSON documents.
- [JSON to TypeScript](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-to-typescript): generate TypeScript declarations.
- [JSON to Zod](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-to-zod): generate a Zod schema.
- [JSON Schema generator](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-schema-generator): infer a JSON Schema from an example.
- [JSON to Go](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-to-go): generate Go structs with JSON tags.
- [JSON to Python](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-to-python): generate Python Pydantic models.
- [JSON to YAML](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-to-yaml): convert JSON to YAML.
- [YAML to JSON](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/yaml-to-json): import YAML as formatted JSON.
- [JSON to CSV](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-to-csv): export JSON records to CSV.
- [CSV to JSON](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/csv-to-json): import CSV records as JSON.
- [JSON to XML](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-to-xml): convert JSON to XML.
- [XML to JSON](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/xml-to-json): import XML as JSON.
- [JSON to Excel](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-to-excel): export JSON records to XLSX.
- [JWT decoder](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/jwt-decoder): inspect a JWT header and payload without verification.
- [JSON to Dart](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-to-dart): null-safe classes with constructors, fromJson and toJson methods.
- [JSON to Kotlin data classes](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-to-kotlin): kotlinx.serialization @Serializable models with @SerialName mappings.
- [JSON to Swift models](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-to-swift): Codable structs with CodingKeys and optional properties.
- [JSON to Java](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-to-java): Java records with nested records and Jackson @JsonProperty mappings.
- [JSON to C# classes](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-to-csharp): System.Text.Json models with required and nullable properties.
- [JSON to Rust structs](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-to-rust): serde derives, key renames, Vec fields and Option types.
- [JSON to PHP classes](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-to-php): PHP 8.1 readonly constructor properties and fromArray methods.
- [JSON to TOML](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-to-toml): tables and arrays of tables, with comments for omitted nulls and large integers.
- [TOML to JSON](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/toml-to-json): local TOML import with tables, scalar values and arrays.
- [Offline JSON formatter](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/offline-json-formatter): installation, caching, offline verification, storage and updates.
- [Secure JSON formatter](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/secure-json-formatter): local document processing, network verification, analytics disclosure and CSP limits.
- [JSONL viewer](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/jsonl-viewer): browse JSON Lines and NDJSON records as a tree or table.
- [NDJSON to JSON](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/ndjson-to-json): turn JSON Lines into one JSON array.
- [JSONL to CSV](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/jsonl-to-csv): JSON Lines records to CSV with dotted columns for nested fields.
- [JSON to JSONL](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-to-jsonl): one compact JSON record per line from an array.
- [Sort JSON keys](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/sort-json-keys): sort object keys alphabetically at every level.
- [JSON escape and unescape](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-escape): a JSON document as one escaped string, and back.
- [JSON repair](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-repair): fix quotes, commas, comments and other common mistakes.
- [JSON to table](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-to-table): a sortable grid with one row per record.
- [JSON path finder](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/json-path-finder): copy the path to any value, or jump to a path.
- [Large JSON file viewer](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/tools/large-json-viewer): JSON and JSON Lines files of any size, read from disk a piece at a time (never uploaded): browse while it indexes, search, go to a path, the shape of every record, edit and save, split or convert to CSV.

## Other languages

The JSON viewer, the tools hub and the dedicated tool pages are also available in eight languages, under the same English slugs (for example /de/tools/json-validator). Each page links its language versions with hreflang. Blog posts, resources and error guides are in English only.

- [Español](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/es): [herramientas JSON](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/es/tools)
- [Português (Brasil)](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/pt): [ferramentas JSON](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/pt/tools)
- [Deutsch](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/de): [JSON-Tools](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/de/tools)
- [Français](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/fr): [outils JSON](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/fr/tools)
- [日本語](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/ja): [JSON ツール](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/ja/tools)
- [한국어](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/ko): [JSON 도구](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/ko/tools)
- [简体中文](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/zh): [JSON 工具](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/zh/tools)
- [Русский](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/ru): [инструменты JSON](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/ru/tools)

## JSON error guides

- [JSON errors hub](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/json-errors): choose a guide by diagnostic message and root cause.
- [Unexpected token '<' / DOCTYPE is not valid JSON](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/json-errors/unexpected-token-html): Fix JSON parsing failures caused by HTML responses. Inspect the response status, content type and body before parsing in JavaScript, Python or Go.
- [Unexpected end of JSON input: empty or truncated data](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/json-errors/unexpected-end-of-json-input): Find and fix empty responses and truncated JSON behind Unexpected end of JSON input, Python Expecting value at char 0 and Go EOF errors.
- ["undefined" or "[object Object]" is not valid JSON](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/json-errors/undefined-is-not-valid-json): Fix JSON.parse calls that receive undefined or an already-parsed object. Learn when to parse, when to stringify and how to guard missing storage values.
- [Expecting property name enclosed in double quotes](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/json-errors/single-quotes-unquoted-keys): Fix single-quoted strings and unquoted keys in JSON. Compare exact Python and JavaScript errors and serialize objects without unsafe quote replacement.
- [JSON trailing comma errors in objects and arrays](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/json-errors/trailing-comma): Remove trailing commas that strict JSON parsers reject. See version-specific JavaScript, Python and .NET messages and generate valid JSON with serializers.
- [JSONDecodeError: Extra data and multiple JSON values](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/json-errors/extra-data): Fix Python JSONDecodeError: Extra data and JavaScript Unexpected non-whitespace character after JSON. Tell one JSON document from NDJSON and parse each correctly.
- [Bad control character in string literal in JSON](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/json-errors/bad-control-character): Fix unescaped newlines, tabs and other control characters inside JSON strings. See exact JavaScript and Python errors and use serializers to escape values.
- [Go JSON: invalid character looking for beginning of value](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/json-errors/go-invalid-character): Diagnose unexpected prefixes, plain-text errors and byte-order marks in Go JSON input. Check HTTP bodies and use SyntaxError.Offset to locate the bad byte.
- [Expecting ',' delimiter / Expected ',' or '}' after property value](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/json-errors/expecting-comma-delimiter): Fix missing commas and unescaped double quotes behind Python Expecting ',' delimiter and JavaScript Expected ',' or '}' errors, with exact messages by runtime.
- [Bad escaped character in JSON / Invalid \escape](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/json-errors/invalid-escape): Fix backslashes JSON cannot read, such as Windows paths, regex patterns and \' escapes. Exact JavaScript, Python, Firefox, Go and .NET messages, with fixes.
- [JSON.parse: unexpected character at line 1 column 1 of the JSON data](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/json-errors/firefox-unexpected-character): Decode the Firefox JSON.parse error: what the first character means, how line and column are counted, and the Chrome, Safari and Node wording for the same input.
- [PHP json_decode returns null: Syntax error and other causes](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/json-errors/php-json-decode-null): Find out why json_decode returns null with JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR or json_last_error_msg, then fix syntax errors, BOMs, invalid UTF-8 and depth limits.
- [C# JSON: '<' is an invalid start of a value / Unexpected character](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/json-errors/dotnet-invalid-start-of-value): Fix System.Text.Json '<' is an invalid start of a value and Json.NET Unexpected character encountered while parsing value, including Blazor and HttpClient cases.
- [Jackson: Unrecognized token / Unexpected character ('<' (code 60))](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/json-errors/jackson-unrecognized-token): Diagnose Jackson JsonParseException messages such as Unrecognized token 'abc' and Unexpected character ('<' (code 60)), including Spring JSON parse error responses.
- [TypeError: Converting circular structure to JSON](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/json-errors/circular-structure): Read the V8 circular path, find the property that closes the loop and serialize plain data instead. Covers Firefox, Safari, Python, Go, .NET and Jackson.
- [TypeError: Do not know how to serialize a BigInt](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/json-errors/bigint-serialize): Serialize BigInt values without losing precision. Choose strings, JSON.rawJSON or a replacer, and read large integer IDs back safely in JavaScript.
- [TypeError: Object of type … is not JSON serializable](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/json-errors/not-json-serializable): Fix Python json.dumps errors for datetime, Decimal, set, bytes, UUID, NumPy values and custom classes, plus NaN values rejected with allow_nan=False.
- [Jackson: Cannot deserialize value of type from Array or Object value](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/json-errors/jackson-cannot-deserialize): Fix Jackson MismatchedInputException when JSON arrays, objects and strings do not match your Java types, including the older START_ARRAY and START_OBJECT messages.
- [Jackson: Unrecognized field, not marked as ignorable](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/json-errors/jackson-unrecognized-field): Fix Jackson UnrecognizedPropertyException: map renamed keys, ignore unknown properties on purpose, and know the Jackson 3 and Spring defaults.
- [Go JSON: cannot unmarshal string, object or array into Go value](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/json-errors/go-cannot-unmarshal): Fix Go UnmarshalTypeError when JSON strings, numbers, objects or arrays do not match your struct fields. Read the field path, then use string tags or json.Number.

## For AI agents in the browser (WebMCP)

In browsers with [WebMCP](https://webmachinelearning.github.io/webmcp/), the viewer and every /tools page register these functions with `document.modelContext`, so a browser agent can call them instead of clicking. They work on the document open in the page's editor, show their result in the page and return text; edits can be undone by the user. The same list, as JSON: [/.well-known/mcp.json](https://tools.vikasmaur.com/.well-known/mcp.json).

- `open_json`: open JSON, JSON Lines, a JWT, or YAML, XML, CSV or TOML text in the editor.
- `check_json`: validity, each error's line and column, size, values and depth.
- `get_json_value`: one value by JSONPath or JSON Pointer, with its keys (for large documents).
- `repair_json`: fix trailing commas, comments, single quotes, unquoted keys, Python literals and similar, in place.
- `format_json`: pretty (2, 4 or tab), minified or escaped, optionally with sorted keys.
- `convert_json`: TypeScript, Zod, JSON Schema, C#, Dart, Java, Python (Pydantic), Go, Kotlin, Swift, PHP, Rust, CSV, YAML, XML, TOML or JSON Lines.
- `import_to_json`: turn YAML, XML, CSV, TSV or TOML into JSON, in place.
- `compare_json`: differences with paths, and an RFC 6902 JSON Patch.
- `decode_jwt`: header, payload and times of a JWT (signature not verified).
- `download_file`: save the document, the formatted output, converted code or data, an Excel workbook or a graph image (PNG, JPEG, SVG) to the user's device.
- `share_link`: a link (or a Markdown or HTML "View in Tool Kumar" button) that opens the document; the data travels in the link's fragment.
- `show_view`: show the format, tree, table or graph view.

## Site facts

- The parser and formatter run in the browser.
- No account is required to use the viewer.
- The app supports graph, tree and table views, search, JSON paths, comparison, conversion and local downloads.
- Share links keep document data in the URL hash; the service does not process the document on a server.
